data.title: 泽塔 · 汇报后的余温
data.description: 泽塔独自留在谒见厅，风衣还带着夜里的寒气。她坐在椅上，任敞开的衣襟滑向两侧；想起暗影大人的赞许，耳尖悄悄泛红，手也从椅沿移向腿间。
data.location: 阴影庭园地下谒见厅·深夜
data.action: 独自坐在椅上，风衣敞开，战服拉链拉开，一手扶着椅沿，一手探向腿间
data.lighting: cold blue magic-stone light of the audience chamber
data.promptProse: Alone after her report, adult Zeta sits on a chair in the dim audience chamber, her trench coat open and bodysuit unzipped, one hand on the chair and the other between her thighs as she blushes.
data.animaCaption: Zeta sits alone with her finished report beside the chair.
